zh-CN.title: 释迦牟尼佛（乔达摩·悉达多）
zh-CN.subtitle: 佛教教法源头、僧团记忆与跨区域传播的核心人物
zh-CN.shortSummary: 释迦牟尼是佛教思想和朝圣地理的核心入口，但早期文本中的片段性生平、后世佛传和神圣叙事必须分层展示。
curatorialDescription: 本馆把释迦牟尼的历史性问题、早期佛教文本中的传述、鹿野苑的教法记忆和后世经典中的佛陀形象连接起来，但不把后世完整佛传倒写成一份同时代传记。
鹿野苑可以成为‘人物—事件—地点—言说—后世朝圣’的完整样本；现实地图显示遗址，神圣意义和佛教记忆则标注为传统与后世层。
zh-CN.researchNote: 早期佛教文本并不提供一份连贯的现代传记；年代采用宽泛导航区间，初转法轮与鹿野苑关系分别标记为早期传述、遗产记忆和后世朝圣层。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 传统与学术年代有争议；约公元前 5 世纪导航区间

interpretation.zh-CN: 《相应部》56.11 的传述层以佛陀宣说四圣谛呈现此句；本馆把它作为教法传述入口，不声称可恢复现场逐字记录。
interpretation.en: SN 56.11 presents this through a transmitted layer of the Buddha's first teaching; the museum uses it as a teaching-context entry, not as a recoverable verbatim transcript.

en.title: Śākyamuni Buddha (Gautama)
en.subtitle: A source figure of Buddhist teaching, monastic memory and transregional transmission
en.shortSummary: Śākyamuni is a central gateway into Buddhist thought and pilgrimage geography, but fragmentary early-text biographies, later Buddha legends and sacred narratives must remain layered.
curatorialDescription: The museum connects the historical question, transmitted accounts in early Buddhist texts, the teaching memory of Sarnath and later scriptural representations of the Buddha without projecting a complete later biography into the same period.

Sarnath becomes a full person–event–place–speech–later pilgrimage sample: the real map shows the archaeological site, while sacred meaning and Buddhist memory remain marked as traditional and later layers.
en.researchNote: Early Buddhist texts do not provide one coherent modern biography. Dates use a broad navigational range; the Sarnath connection is separated into early transmission, heritage memory and later pilgrimage layers.
en.timeLabel: Traditional and scholarly dates contested; broad fifth-century BCE navigation range
